segments.name: North America
segments.description: Sells Ralph Lauren branded apparel, handbags, footwear, accessories and home products through retail and wholesale in the U.S. and Canada.
segments.evidence: Our North America segment, representing approximately 41% of our Fiscal 2026 net revenues, primarily consists of sales of our Ralph Lauren branded apparel, handbags, footwear & accessories, home, and related products made through our retail and wholesale businesses primarily in the U.S. and Canada.

segments.name: Europe
segments.description: Sells Ralph Lauren branded apparel, handbags, footwear, accessories and home products through retail and wholesale in Europe and emerging markets.
segments.evidence: Our Europe segment, representing approximately 31% of our Fiscal 2026 net revenues, primarily consists of sales of our Ralph Lauren branded apparel, handbags, footwear & accessories, home, and related products made through our retail and wholesale businesses in Europe and emerging markets.

segments.name: Asia
segments.description: Sells Ralph Lauren branded apparel, handbags, footwear, accessories and home products through retail and wholesale in Asia, Australia and New Zealand.
segments.evidence: Our Asia segment, representing approximately 26% of our Fiscal 2026 net revenues, primarily consists of sales of our Ralph Lauren branded apparel, handbags, footwear & accessories, home, and related products made through our retail and wholesale businesses in Asia, Australia, and New Zealand.

revenueModel.text: Consumers and wholesale customers pay Ralph Lauren for branded apparel, handbags, footwear, accessories and home products, and licensees pay royalties.
revenueModel.evidence: Our wholesale business in North America is comprised primarily of sales to department stores and, to a lesser extent, specialty stores.
